verdict.rationale: The only agent-relevant least-privilege control in the evidence is that the official MCP server cannot access production deployments by default, as a safety measure. Beyond that, Convex leaves authorization to developer-built code in functions rather than offering a credential-scoping framework. There is no evidence of issuing scoped or least-privilege API keys or tokens for an agent. Missing for 10: documented scoped API keys or deploy tokens, per-credential permission or role scoping, credential revocation and rotation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
